where: Nightreach Observatory (the star-temple town, last Lumenary, densest starfield in the game)
mood: Under the Whole Sky: vast, lonely, wondrous - a single voice under every star, faint telescope clockwork, minor lifting toward major like hope dawning.
core_styles: A minor resolving to C major
lonely spacious pulse-wave lead with long notes and wide intervals
slow glassy arpeggiated pad of broken chords like turning starlight
faint dry clockwork tick on a steady subdivision instead of a drum kit
vast, lonely, reverent, wondrous star-observatory town theme

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {stepping out under the whole sky: a soft clockwork tick begins, a slow glassy arpeggio unfolds upward like the dome opening, one high bell, then the lead enters}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the lonely star melody in A minor: a slow wide rising leap that hangs in the air, unfolding over the slow arpeggio, clockwork ticking beneath}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the melody again, now answered by a soft second voice a phrase later across the dome, strings warming underneath}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: the lift to C major and F major - the melody opens into hope, bells brightening like constellations relighting one by one, a near-dawn glow, then easing back to A minor}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the lonely melody returns under the stars; the last bar leads straight back into the main theme}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
